classes.B: Normalization denominator or explicitly named ratio

review.ground: reference and constant setpoint separated; actual-volume optimizer, actual branch-flow Rb; fixed water/refrigerant UA references
review.fan: former rated-flow upper bound separated into reference/min/max in common solver and all three air-side models
review.compressor: displacement does not supply speed bounds; speed solver brackets explicit rps_min/rps_max; no normalized-speed upper clamp
review.WSHPB: fixed source-water/tank UAs, no fan/rated-flow ceiling; existing source flow and explicit speed/mixing limits retain meanings
review.clamps: No UA-to-rated or ratio-to-one clamp found. Nonnegative fan-power protection and ULP endpoint clamping retained.
